div.head: Ps Cn for 10
div.ab: Sintque mediocrium et minutorum cause et earum correctiones tam criminalium quam ciuilium per prouidam sapientiam et rationem primariorum iudicate et decise; primariorum uero enormia, si que fuerint — ne scelus aliquod remaneat inultum —, nosmet in [curi]a nostra regali puniemus et a[nimaduer]temus.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 622 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: And let the cases of the middling and lesser men, and their correction, criminal as well as civil, be judged and decided by the provident wisdom and reason of the chief men; but the enormities of the chief men, if there are any (lest any crime remain unavenged), we ourselves shall punish in our royal [court] and [chastise].

note.seg: für landrechtlichen Frevel, Besitz und Eigenthum unterstanden Forstbeamte schwerlich je einem Forstgericht: dessen Zuständigkeit so auszudehnen wünschte wohl nur ein Forstrichter. Vielmehr durch Königsrichter allgemeiner Kronprocesse, nicht Forstrichter, inquisitio querenda erat de prisis et tenseriis omnium .. forestariorum laut Verordnung von 1194; Hoveden III 267. Vielleicht kannte Verf., wie andere Anglonormann. Juristen, Fränkisches Recht und daraus die Form. imper. n. 43: Quidquid tam liberi forestarii quam serui nocuerint, magistri forestariorum illorum iustitiam facient, ed. Zeumer Mon. Germ., Formulae Merow. et Karol. 320

For offences, property and ownership under the general law, forest officials were hardly ever subject to a forest court: probably only a forest justice would have wished to extend its competence so far. Rather, by royal justices of the general crown pleas, not forest justices, inquisitio querenda erat de prisis et tenseriis omnium .. forestariorum, according to the ordinance of 1194; Hoveden III 267. Perhaps the author, like other Anglo-Norman jurists, knew Frankish law and from it the Form. imper. n. 43: Quidquid tam liberi forestarii quam serui nocuerint, magistri forestariorum illorum iustitiam facient, ed. Zeumer Mon. Germ., Formulae Merow. et Karol. 320
